findings.reason: The exact outer envelope and 6 MiB UTF-8 limit are checked before reusing both unchanged native readers. The complete response, original inputs, received timestamp and calendar identity bind the note section. All occurrence/date records are validated before replacement of a newly created isolated model; late invalid, duplicate, unknown and inconsistent-history records cannot partially mutate the live model. An empty valid note set prepares an independent empty model.

preparePlanView builds native state and response fragments without mutating the live view or worksheet. The full model, inputs, source label and response view are prepared before review. Apply checks the still-current pending record, discards it and calls a synchronous accept path. That path replaces the week, original form inputs, accepted origin, complete note model and calendar session. The existing synchronous render path may briefly sync the previous model against the new state; its source guard is caught, and the prepared model is installed before control returns. No awaited input-dependent work occurs within acceptance.

File reads use a revision ticket plus exact accepted-origin, state and model identity checks before and after preparation. Note edits notify before mutating the same model. Source changes, form input, date/arrangement changes, separate-note replacement, cancellation, competing handoff reads and page departure invalidate pending review. Apply rechecks immediately before acceptance.

Apply increments the ordinary request generation and aborts its previous controller before accepting the handoff. The unchanged request controller checks generation after awaited transport/read completion and before delivering results/errors, so a transport that completes after abort cannot overwrite the accepted handoff.

Review builds filename, source, inputs, scheduled and omitted occurrence descriptions and all note records with textContent. It distinguishes retained source checks from caregiver-entered notes, reports records for other dates, and explicitly describes empty-note clearing. Native state/origin and the existing calendar identity remain in the combined format. Retained desktop screenshot shows the literal filename, original source/input disclosure and scheduled/omitted review.

Both native file codecs remain unchanged. The original render entry point delegates to prepare then commit. Worksheet additions are optional notification, snapshot and prepared-model acceptance hooks. The candidate's eight changed paths match its declared boundary.
